thread:
Support Bot: Escalation — ingest throttling impacting onboarding flows for Gridly, NovaPay, and HealthArc. Receiving 429s since 12:05 PT, ~2,100 docs queued. Raising to CS for priority handling and comms. @Cheng L @Alex M @Maria S
Cheng L: On it. Quick clarifying q: are these Hosted accounts or Dedicated? Any PII in the payloads?
Support Bot: Hosted accounts. No PII present in the queued payloads. Sample error: `quota_exceeded: ingest_rate_limit` repeated across multiple tenants. Link to sanitized logs: https://internal-logs.redwood/ingest/199876 (internal)
Alex M: Thanks. Can support paste backlog size (docs + tokens) and the current rate limit values? We need that to estimate ETA for a backfill.
Support Bot: Backlog: 2,100 docs ≈ 450k tokens. Current per-account ingest rate = 100 req/min. System capacity is saturated due to burst from multiple onboardings.
Maria S: Heads up — Gridly is in POC and renewal touchpoint in ~45 days. This is a renewal risk if they see delays. We should prepare a customer-facing message and temporary mitigation (quota bump or dedicated ingest window).
CS Lead: Agreed. Proposed comms plan: 1) immediate proactive note to affected customers acknowledging issue + apology; 2) offer temporary quota bump + expedited backfill window; 3) follow-up recap & credit offer for impacted customers if SLA targets missed; 4) internal exec escalation if any churn signals. Draft customer message below.
Alex M: Share draft and the exact steps for ops to do the bump. Also tag finance if credits > $X.
CS Lead: Draft (please copy/paste and customize per customer):

```
Hi <Customer Team>,

We’re contacting you because we detected an ingestion delay that affected your recent uploads. We’re sorry for the disruption. Our engineers are actively processing the backlog and can provision a temporary ingest rate increase to clear queued items.

What we’re doing now:
- Provisioning a temporary quota increase to accelerate backfill
- Monitoring progress and will update every 30–60 minutes
- Offering a post-incident review and, if appropriate, a credit for the impact

Estimated time to clear backlog: ~3–4 hours after increase is applied.

If you’d like us to schedule a dedicated backfill window or want us to do the backfill for you, please reply to this message and we’ll coordinate immediately.

Apologies again — your CS rep (Maria S) is on hand: maria@redwood.com, +1-555-0102.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Platform Team
```

Cheng L: Ops steps to trigger temporary bump (internal) — runbook excerpt:
```bash
# POST to internal admin API to bump ingest rate for tenant
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/admin/tenants/{tenant_id}/quota
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"ingest_rate": 250, "duration_minutes": 240}'
# then trigger backfill job:
POST https://internal-api.redwood/tenants/{tenant_id}/jobs -d '{"type":"ingest_backfill"}'
```
Support Bot: I initiated the bump for NovaPay (bump_id: bump-AX7). NovaPay backlog cleared — final count 720 docs. Completed at 12:50 PT.
Alex M: Nice. Can we bump Gridly next and confirm the expected run time?
Support Bot: Kicked Gridly bump at 12:57 PT (bump_id: bump-GZ4). Estimated time based on tokens + new rate ≈ 3.5 hours. I'll post progress every 30 mins.
Katie R: Runbook link for reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingest-throttle — follow steps 2–5 for bump + backfill verification.
Maria S: I’ll send the drafted customer message to Gridly and NovaPay now (tailored). For HealthArc, offering an optional dedicated ingest window tomorrow AM or credit. Finance: if we propose credits > $1k, please pre-approve — tagging for visibility.
CS Lead: Action items: Cheng — coordinate with support to apply bumps for remaining two customers and monitor. Support — post progress updates (every 30 mins). Maria — send comms and copy renewals for Gridly. Alex — schedule a 1:1 check after backfill completes to assess mitigation and any long-term changes (e.g., quota adjustments or onboarding guidance). I’ll own exec escalation if Gridly surfaces churn risk.
Support Bot: Status update 13:27 PT — Gridly processing at increased rate, throughput +60% observed. Remaining docs ≈ 1,100.
Cheng L: Monitoring looks healthy. No errors introduced by the bump. I’ll leave the temporary rate for 4 hours and then roll back to standard profile.
Maria S: Gridly acknowledged the comms and asked for hourly updates. I told them ETA ~1:40 PT and that we’ll follow up with a recap + offer.
CS Lead: :thumbsup: keep this thread updated. If any customer requests an exec call, flag me immediately.
Support Bot: Final update for thread: NovaPay completed; Gridly in progress (ETA 1:40 PT); HealthArc scheduled for tomorrow window per CS offer. Incident ticket: INC-199876 opened and linked to this thread.
Maria S: Thanks team. I’ll record notes in Gainsight and mark Gridly as 'At Risk — POC' for renewal follow-up.
Alex M: After this, let's run a short postmortem: root cause + recommended quota defaults for POCs.
Cheng L: Agree. Will add perf/ingest metrics to the incident for analysis.
CS Lead: Closing loop: great cross-team response. Update this thread when all backfills complete and when any credit approvals are resolved.
